title: feat: NavigationDesigner — icon editing, visibility toggle, export/import, responsive layout
body:
Enhances the NavigationDesigner with missing capabilities from the Navigation Tree Designer spec: node property editing (icon, visibility), schema import/export, and mobile layout.

### NavigationDesigner component
- **Icon editing** — Pencil button per node reveals inline text input for icon name (Enter/Escape commit/discard)
- **Visibility toggle** — Eye/EyeOff button toggles `visible: false` on NavigationItem, renders "Hidden" badge + opacity
- **Export/Import JSON** — Toolbar buttons: Export downloads `.json` file, Import accepts file upload. Optional `onExport`/`onImport` callback props for custom handling
- **Responsive layout** — `flex-col` on mobile, `sm:flex-row` on desktop

```tsx
<NavigationDesigner
  items={navItems}
  onChange={setNavItems}
  onExport={(items) => saveToBackend(items)}
  onImport={(items) => loadFromBackend(items)}
/>
```

### i18n
- 9 new keys (`navEditIcon`, `navToggleVisible`, `navHidden`, `navExportSchema`, `navImportSchema`, etc.) across all 10 locales
- `useDesignerTranslation` fallback dictionary updated

### Tests
- 15 new tests → 33 total (icon editing, visibility toggle, export/import callbacks, read-only guards, responsive classes)
- 380 tests passing across 19 files

### ROADMAP
- Updated P1.11 Navigation Designer checklist, i18n key count (103), test count (33/180)
